defects.title: Dormant legacy SoulFactory Provisioner still contains placeholder provisioning logic
defects.observed_behavior: The legacy Provisioner path contained TODO/for-now/skipped-stage logic behind soulFactoryReady=false, while app startup installed FullProvisioner instead.
defects.intended_behavior: Remove the dormant path so no placeholder provisioning implementation can become reachable; a reactor without an explicitly installed production engine must fail closed and publish only terminal error output.
defects.verification_notes: Resolved by deleting internal/soulfactory/provisioner.go, preserving default unavailableProvisioningEngine behavior, and adding TestDefaultReactorProvisioningPublishesOnlyErrorWithoutEngine. Verified by SFOM-T-022 through SFOM-T-024 for Bead bahia-j28b.
